text:
linus: FYI egress audit log volume jumped ~6x since we rolled the proxy NACL at 10:05. Also seeing GPU allocs stuck in provisioning across us-west2. Anyone already digging?
maya: saw the spike, looks like denied connections to kms from private subnets — audit shows 403s to KMS endpoint. Might be IAM role change?
samir: I rolled a small IAM tweak for private-proxy -> kms yesterday. Could that cause it? I only added explicit principal arn to the key policy.
maya: if key policy blocks, KMS returns AccessDenied on decrypt, not 403 on the network layer. logs show TLS handshake failures then 403s.
aj: assigning myself. ops-bot: triggered node health checks for us-west2 GPU fleet?
ops-bot: node-check: 12/136 GPUs reporting kernel panics in nodepool-gpu-2, restarting kubelets, ETA 4m.
linus: kernel panics + KMS handshake errors... could be MTU/egress firewall + iptables change from proxy rollout.
samir: I changed the proxy SG to restrict 0.0.0.0/0 egress -> we meant to keep 443 open to kms.amazonaws.com but accidentally limited to the subnet. checking.
maya: also seeing increased latency on prefix cache lookups, more failed caching -> more tokens to model servers -> higher load.
aj: temporary mitigation: can we fallback GPU provisioning to eu-west1 for critical jobs? how to move new leases?
linus: set routing policy in fleet-controller: `kubectl patch deploy fleet-controller -n infra --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"controller","env":[{"name":"DEFAULT_REGION","value":"eu-west1"}]}]}}}}'` — but that's heavy.
samir: quick hack: tag jobs with `region:failover` and adjust autoscaler rule to prefer eu-west1. I'll open PR.
maya: Security question: if we flip regions, we need to ensure KMS key is replicated or customer-data remains encrypted. Check KMS multi-region alias.
aj: @security-bot can we get a quick audit to see which keys have multi-region replicas and which customers would be impacted?
security-bot: audit-keybot: scanned 12 keys used by prod-gpu, 3 not multi-region. list: key-abc, key-def, key-ghi.
linus: OK don't move those tenants. For others, start failover. Samir, can you revert the proxy SG to allow kms hostnames?
samir: reverting now: `aws ec2 modify-security-group-rules --group-id sg-0abcd --replace ...` will update in 30s.
ops-bot: change detected: proxy-sg updated, egress 443 -> kms hostnames. Rolling restart of proxy pods.
maya: after revert, TLS handshakes recovered, KMS 200s now. GPU node restarts still ongoing, but kubelets back up on 9 nodes.
aj: cost note: failing over to eu-west1 increases egress and model cross-region charges approx +$0.08/token estimated. flagging finance.
linus: create incident ticket? maybe sev-2 until all nodes stable and audit logs catch up.
maya: filed INC-2026, added logs link: https://logs.internal/redwood/INC-2026
samir: root cause likely proxy SG change + unexpected iptables upgrade on node image that surfaced kernel bug under high TLS churn. Will schedule rolling image patch.
aj: action items: 1) revert proxy SG (done), 2) tag and failover safe tenants, 3) schedule kernel patch, 4) KMS multi-region plan for non-replicated keys. Assign: samir/maya/linus.
linus: thanks. :thumbsup:
maya: closing thread once nodes at 100% and audit shows no more 403s.
aj: ping if anything else.
